QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_6

question.text: Vedant Capital is negotiating the hurdle rate for its maiden Category I venture capital AIF. What is the typical Indian-market hurdle rate range per Ch 9?

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 9 states Indian AIF hurdle rates are generally 7% to 12% p.a. in INR terms, while international standards are generally 5% to 8% p.a. in USD terms. The Indian range reflects higher domestic equity-return expectations. The Trap: Option A is below typical risk-free rates and too low to be a meaningful preferred return. Option B is in the territory of target IRRs, not the hurdle. Option D is unreasonably high relative to the stated workbook range. Note: The hurdle is the preferred return that investors receive before the manager participates in profits.
